(declare-fun bp_c3_is_3 () Bool)

(assert (=> bp_c1_is_2 (= cell1 2)))
(assert (=> bp_c1_is_3 (= cell1 3)))
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) bp_c2_is_1 bp_c2_is_2 bp_c2_is_3))
(assert (=> bp_c2_is_1 (= cell2 1)))
(assert (=> bp_c2_is_2 (= cell2 2)))
(assert (=> bp_c2_is_3 (= cell2 3)))
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) bp_c3_is_1 bp_c3_is_2 bp_c3_is_3))
(assert (=> bp_c3_is_1 (= cell3 1)))
(assert (=> bp_c3_is_2 (= cell3 2)))
(assert (=> bp_c3_is_3 (= cell3 3)))
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) bp_c1_is_1 bp_c2_is_1 bp_c3_is_1))
(assert ((_ pbeq 1 1 1 1) bp_c1_is_2 bp_c2_is_2 bp_c3_is_2))
